rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=16, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=0.3, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.9, rationale=iter-6: NFE probe, fd_recon_steps 8->16 (last orthogonal sampler lever; more Euler steps = finer few-step integration). PRIOR: eta 1.0->0.3 (iter-5) left RMSE dead flat (0.01357->0.01355) -> the DPS guidance term is NOT the error; the error is in the base flow velocity (out-of-domain Mayo prior). FAILURE MODE fully characterized across 3 levers (dc_relax, init_t, eta): RMSE floor ~0.0135, immovably ~2.6x the 0.00521 sparse-FBP baseline_rmse -> hr=0. ONE KNOB: steps 8->16. HYPOTHESIS: strong prior this lands flat too - if the prior velocity is mis-scaled, integrating it more finely cannot help RMSE; a null result closes the 4-lever map and confirms the hr=0 ceiling is regime-bound (out-of-domain prior on sparse breast), after which iters 7-20 are regime-bound confirmation. best-RMSE base (init_t 0.4, eta held at iter-5 0.3), dc_relax 0.9. Budget: 2x steps ~370s, inside 20 min.
